verdict.rationale: Calendly's first-party docs describe a dedicated Webhook API with webhook subscriptions. Payloads are delivered in real time to your endpoint when invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule. Webhook signing keys let you verify that deliveries are authentic. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook subscriptions, and evidence of event types beyond scheduling, cancellation, and rescheduling (e.g., routing forms or other resources).
